title: Custom Plugin and Extension Design Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies custom plugin and extension design?
options: Expose a small managed configuration model and defer value reads until consumers need them.
Store extension state in a singleton
questions.answer: Expose a small managed configuration model and defer value reads until consumers need them.
questions.explanation: The correct approach preserves Gradle’s lazy model, explicit data flow, variant correctness, functional evidence and operability.

questions.prompt: A plugin extension should reproduce the full DSL of every plugin it wraps.
questions.explanation: Calling extension.failOnWarnings.get inside apply observes the default before the consuming build script can override it.

questions.prompt: When should an extension Property normally be read?
questions.answer: By a consuming task or late model boundary through its Provider, after build scripts can configure it.
questions.explanation: The answer names the model property that makes the build behaviour predictable rather than relying on incidental script order.
